content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-181. - Misrepresentations.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to make any willful misstatement, falsification,
               or omission of a material fact in conjunction with any application under this article.
(
Ord. No. 4887
, § 1, 1-27-2025)
